title: Passwordless login to Analytics
question: Q1
take: Email-only sign-in that doubles as sign-up; "check your email" step offers mail-client shortcuts and an explicit "Logging in…" state.

title: Developer account sign-up and magic-link login
question: Q1
take: One email form serves both sign-up and log-in via magic link; in-app "Verify your log-in" confirmation before landing in the dashboard.

title: Email Login to Inbox
question: Q1
take: Six-step magic-link login with distinct "sending link" and "link sent" states — the minimum viable passwordless loop.

title: Passwordless sign-in & Organization Setup
question: Q1
take: "Sign in with work email" magic link lands straight in org creation — identity first, workspace second, no password anywhere.

title: Email Magic-Link Onboarding
question: Q1
take: Marketing CTA → auth-method card → email → link sent → empty team workspace; nothing asked beyond an email.

title: Invite teammates
question: Q1
take: One "Add people" modal offers a shareable invite link and email invites side by side, with inline error feedback.

title: SSO authentication settings (admin)
question: Q1
take: Org SSO settings page: "no providers yet" empty state with one "Manage integrations" CTA — SSO as an admin toggle, invisible to end users.

title: Team login policy: none / 2FA or SSO / SSO
question: Q1
take: Three-radio login policy (none / 2FA or SSO / SSO only) with consequence text — org-level enforcement in one control.

title: Admin login settings: SSO, provisioning, domain control
question: Q1
take: Single "Login" admin page with tabs for SSO, user provisioning and domain control — identity settings in one place.

title: Manage sharing and invite collaborator
question: Q2
take: Per-file share settings switch link access to "Only invited people", then invite by email — item-level scope overrides team default.

title: Folder access management
question: Q2
take: Folder "Manage access" dialog with a per-collaborator permission selector and inline confirmation of the change.

title: Folder sharing management
question: Q2
take: Share a document folder to a specific shareholder or group from the folder context menu — you pick a person/group, not a global role.

title: Community Access Management
question: Q2
take: Gate a content area by audience: pick which membership tiers can access the community in a modal — edtech cohort-based scoping.

title: Project sharing & link invite
question: Q2
take: Video-project share menu: send link to recipients (autosuggest) plus separate link settings; includes share error and retry states.

title: Invite client to workspace
question: Q2
take: External-client invite modal lets you adjust what the client can see before sending; pending invite shown in the client list.

title: Invite External Collaborator
question: Q2
take: Guest invited to a single project: a "Review external access" step warns what they will see, then a permission level is chosen.

title: Share modal controls
question: Q2
take: One share modal combines link-access dropdown, collaborator invite, and per-collaborator role change/remove.

title: Share document: invite with role + public link toggle
question: Q2
take: Doc-level modal: invite by email with role, list of guests vs team members, and a public-link toggle — all scoped to one document.

title: Share reel: team-only vs anyone with link
question: Q2
take: Two radios — "Only members in your team" vs "Anyone with the link" — the minimal audience choice for sharing a recording.

title: Import contacts from CSV
question: Q3
take: Canonical CSV import: upload → map columns (auto then manual) → review parsed rows → importing indicator → list.

title: CSV User Import
question: Q3
take: Import wizard maps each CSV column to a user attribute, then ends with a post-import report of created/updated/failed rows.

title: Client Import/Export
question: Q3
take: CSV import with a "mapping required" preview state and column labels applied before a success banner on the client list.

title: Bulk Stakeholder Import
question: Q3
take: Auto-maps columns on upload, then validates on import attempt with row-level errors before committing.

title: Invite people to meal plan
question: Q3
take: Same invite modal supports manual emails or CSV upload; shows format error and an "imported 0 of 5" review list to fix rows.

title: Add and enroll student
question: Q3
take: Add students manually with an "enroll in course" toggle in the same modal, then import feedback and an updated roster.

title: Manage team members
question: Q3
take: Multi-select people in the roster → "Add to group" overlay — groups/cohorts built from the existing member list.

title: Invite Members
question: Q3
take: Paste many emails into one field; the members list immediately reflects pending invites.

title: Invite to team: paste multiple emails
question: Q3
take: Multiline paste box for bulk emails with an "add individually" fallback — one field handles 1 or 100 invites.

title: Admin center: Groups
question: Q3
take: Admin "Groups" area organizes members by department/location with group admins — cohort structure with delegated admin.

title: Admin console: Members list with status filter
question: Q3
take: Admin members table with status filter (invited/active) and Groups as a sibling nav item — roster + cohorts in one console.

title: SSO & provisioning: domain verification
question: Q3
take: "SSO & provisioning" settings with domain-verification tab — directory sync is set up next to SSO, not as a separate product.

title: Team Member Invitation and Role Assignment
question: Q4
take: Role chosen at invite time from a short fixed list with one-line descriptions — no separate role-admin step.

title: Team member roles and access
question: Q4
take: Per-member "roles and access" page: one role plus product-level access toggles — the escape hatch lives on the person, not in a matrix.

title: Invite Members
question: Q4
take: Invite modal with an expandable "view role descriptions" panel so people pick the right role without leaving the flow.

title: Invite Users from Platform Settings
question: Q4
take: Role dropdown plus a "Roles help" explainer inside the invite modal; pending invites list updates in place.

title: Manage team member permission
question: Q4
take: Change a member's permission from the row via a selector and confirm inline — no edit page.

title: Workspace Guest Invitation
question: Q4
take: Separate "Guests" area for external people with a restricted role — guest as a first-class, clearly bounded role.

title: Project Access Management
question: Q4
take: Per-project collaborator roles override the workspace role — the per-item escape hatch next to a small global role set.

title: Add and assign employee permissions
question: Q4
take: COUNTER: role choice, then per-business, then per-permission checklist — 8 steps to add one employee; matrix explosion.

title: User Roles with View permissions
question: Q4
take: Fixed role list (Primary Owner / Owner / Author / Affiliate) with a "View permissions" expander — small set, fully transparent.

title: Workspace members: Members / Guests tabs
question: Q4
take: Members vs Guests tabs; each row shows role and license — guest is a tab, not a role-matrix column.

title: Permission groups (apps x resources x users)
question: Q4
take: COUNTER: "Permission groups" each tracking apps × resources × users — admin must reason about a 3-D matrix to answer "who can see X".

title: Invite link creation
question: Q5
take: Admin-created invite link carries a role, a usage limit and an expiry date — cohort self-enrolment with a built-in shelf life.

title: Team Folder Viewing Link Settings
question: Q5
take: View-only folder link settings with expiration, password and download toggles, plus delete-link — all in one modal.

title: Share link and set permission
question: Q5
take: Switch from restricted to link-based access and choose the link's permission level in the same step, then copy.

title: Share Base Public Link
question: Q5
take: Public link lives on its own "Share publicly" tab, configured separately from collaborator invites.

title: Shareable Link Creation
question: Q5
take: "Configure protections" step before the link is generated — expiry/password set up-front, not as an afterthought.

title: Track share and invite link
question: Q5
take: Track sharing: invite-only vs public, allow downloads, password-protect — media-specific link controls in one panel.

title: Manage track share link
question: Q5
take: Reset share link with a confirmation dialog — old link dies, new one issued; the simplest revoke pattern.

title: Publish Document to Web
question: Q5
take: Publish document to web: published state shows URL + options; unpublish is the inverse toggle.

title: Create and schedule post
question: Q5
take: Schedule a membership post's publication date/time from the post editor — scheduled publish for gated content.

title: Cancel Team Invitation
question: Q5
take: Cancel a pending invite from the admin members row — revoke before the person ever gets in.

title: Edit shared link: permission + expires after
question: Q5
take: Edit an existing per-recipient link: permission dropdown + "Expires after" — expiry remains editable after the link is created.

title: Share item link: expires after + available to
question: Q5
take: "Link expires after" + "Available to" (anyone / specific emails) — two dropdowns cover expiry and audience for a shared item.

title: Sign-in to Business Dashboard
question: Q6
take: After password + 2FA, prompt passkey enrolment so the next login is one step.

title: SSO sign-in with team identifier
question: Q6
take: SSO entry via team identifier with an explicit SSO-initiation error state.

title: SSO email check and error handling
question: Q6
take: Enter email → system checks for SSO config → clear error when the domain has no SSO — email-first routing.

title: Sign-in to Content Home
question: Q6
take: After email, choose "password or one-time code" — lets users skip password recall without a reset.

title: Email Code Sign-In
question: Q6
take: On password mismatch, offer an email code instead of a reset link; handles invalid code and retry.

title: Password reset via one-time code
question: Q6
take: Password reset via one-time code typed inline, no link to click — fewer context switches.

title: Password recovery and reset
question: Q6
take: Complete recovery loop: error → enter email → loading → "instructions sent" → set new password → back in.

title: Two-factor authentication setup
question: Q6
take: 2FA setup shows recovery codes and requires acknowledgement before finishing — recovery set up when access is set up.

title: Login & security: password, passkeys, sign out all
question: Q6
take: Login & security page manages password and passkeys side by side, plus "sign out of all devices".

title: Account recovery: recovery codes
question: Q6
take: Account recovery page lists masked recovery codes with remove and "+ New recovery code" — recovery as a managed inventory.
